bull.b: Accelerating product revenue and higher full-year guidance indicate strong platform demand. Sustained growth across data, AI and enterprise workloads can expand Snowflake’s installed base and deepen customer dependence over the next several quarters.

High net revenue retention and rising large-customer cohorts show that customers are increasing usage after adoption. This supports durable recurring consumption, improves account economics and creates a foundation for cross-selling higher-value platform capabilities.

Meaningful operating and free cash flow gives Snowflake resources to fund product development, AI infrastructure, acquisitions and repurchases without relying solely on external capital. Strong cash conversion also provides resilience while GAAP profitability develops.

bear.b: Gross profitability is strong, but sustained operating expenses keep Snowflake materially unprofitable under GAAP. Continued investment in sales, research and AI may delay earnings conversion and limits the company’s demonstrated ability to scale profits.

The shift toward a more debt-heavy capital structure raises financial risk while losses persist and equity returns remain deeply negative. Although the balance sheet is not distressed, higher leverage reduces flexibility if growth or cash generation weakens.

AI is a major growth opportunity, but lower product margins and possible customer limits on token consumption could weaken the economics of expansion. Snowflake must achieve infrastructure efficiencies and prove durable AI monetization as usage scales.
